item_tool.txt fixture -- see PROVENANCE.md.

ITEM_TOOL_WHEELBARROW and ITEM_TOOL_MINECART blocks below are QUOTED
verbatim from the audit sec8, which read item_tool.txt lines 213-223
(wheelbarrow) and 200-211 (minecart) on the real install and reproduced
them as a code block, matching research/2026-09-18-production-figures.md's
wiki-sourced figures digit-for-digit. ITEM_TOOL_JUG and ITEM_TOOL_LARGE_POT
are RECONSTRUCTED: the audit quotes the individual SIZE (300/5000) and
CONTAINER_CAPACITY (10000/60000) values in prose (sec8) but not as full
blocks, so the block form here is this stream's assembly of those verified
numbers. MATERIAL_SIZE is carried over from the quoted wheelbarrow/minecart
blocks; the audit did not report a MATERIAL_SIZE for jug/large pot, so it
is omitted there rather than guessed.

[OBJECT:ITEM]

wheelbarrow and minecart -- QUOTED verbatim, audit sec8:

[ITEM_TOOL:ITEM_TOOL_WHEELBARROW]
[VALUE:50]
[SIZE:30000]
[MATERIAL_SIZE:6]
[CONTAINER_CAPACITY:100000]

[ITEM_TOOL:ITEM_TOOL_MINECART]
[VALUE:50]
[SIZE:40000]
[MATERIAL_SIZE:6]
[CONTAINER_CAPACITY:500000]

jug and large pot -- RECONSTRUCTED block form, QUOTED individual values:

[ITEM_TOOL:ITEM_TOOL_JUG]
[SIZE:300]
[CONTAINER_CAPACITY:10000]

[ITEM_TOOL:ITEM_TOOL_LARGE_POT]
[SIZE:5000]
[CONTAINER_CAPACITY:60000]
